race.description: Kia Ora Bloodlines To Headlines Hcp (Bm88)
race.comment: BARRENGARRY (9) progressive gelding ready to tackle this trip and stronger company. Produced sharp figures again second up with the 60.5kg to defeat inferior opposition over 1600m at Randwick in Midway grade. Hard to knock winning form and Lloyd sticks with the big weight drop. Looks ready for this. MISTER RIZZ (10) opened this prep with a slick win two runs ago. Sat on the good tempo and found plenty second up with a narrow fourth over 1900m at this track. Fitter now and drawn to get every chance. STARZINTHEIREYES (4) lightly raced gelding who's been unlucky in his two starts this prep. Jumped in trip and looked to have the race in his keeping only to be nailed on the line as fav over 1900m at this track. Can get cover from the draw and play a leading role. ANTHRACITE (11) holding his form and comes up with the rails draw again. Assess on his good second to Aethelwulf over this trip here three back. MUKHTALIF (12) at his top now and can take a hand in the finish.
